scope: surface-only localization of CT label-derived posterior vertebral proxies; not acupoint or prone deployment accuracy
source: TotalSegmentator small v2.0.1, 102 cases; source qualification separately documented
target: posterior-most 2-percent label voxel mean projected at its X/Z to CT-only posterior surface
target_valid: nonempty label, no scanner-boundary contact, finite surface projection, bone-to-skin posterior distance in [0,200] mm
case_eligible: at least 3 valid target levels; original surface has >=10000 valid columns; all valid proxy levels ordered C7>T3>T5>T9>L2 in RAS Z
split: shuffle 98 author-train IDs; first70 train, next14 dev, final14 test, then apply the fixed case qualification within each role; author-val4 supporting only; development source s0011/s0250 moved to train before freezing
input: CT-only posterior heightfield/valid mask, physical image-plane coordinate channels; 128x128 full scanner field, no bone-driven ROI
encoder: same CNN4 ->16 ->32 ->64 ->96, four stride2 blocks; independently trained same optimizer
query: five reference tokens cross-attend to surface features via two 96-dimensional four-head decoder layers; X sigmoid, Y uses positive six-gap normalization enforcing C7<T3<T5<T9<L2 in superior-to-inferior image row
loss: masked squared normalized X/Z coordinate error; no medical/shape/pseudo-label losses
checkpoint: smallest dev mean physical X/Z error; check every 10 epochs; all runs retained
augmentation: none in this first source-domain pilot; no hidden synthetic prone conversion
metrics: per-level physical X/Z median/P95 and 3D predicted-surface query distance conditional on hit; surface hit coverage and common-hit paired distance; ordered-level violations
aggregation: all targets within case -> case mean; model seeds within case -> median; equal-weight cases within split
missing_hit: not imputed or clamped; report miss and common-hit, no favorable score by discarding missed queries
method_decision: requires independent test gain over train-median and plain global regression across seeds; no promotion to clinical/PressurePose inference from CT-only result
pretraining_source_amendment: Entire s1373 train-source excluded after raw CT/source-label qualification showed C7 inferior to T9/L2; no trained model or exam results existed. No guessed relabeling.
